rows.label: M500 in-car video system
rows.establishes: 130 in-car systems were quoted, ordered and delivered.
rows.does_not_establish: How many were installed or operating at any time.

rows.label: M500 ALPR DVR component
rows.establishes: Every delivered system included a component the vendor's pack list names “M500 ALPR DVR.”
rows.does_not_establish: That plate reading was enabled on any unit, or when.
rows.caveat: Hardware naming, not a separate licence. Carried at $0 because its cost sits inside the subscription.

rows.label: VideoManager EL Cloud (video evidence management)
rows.establishes: Cloud video evidence management was part of the purchase.
rows.does_not_establish: Anything about plate data. This product handles video evidence.

rows.label: M500 Basic ALPR VaaS (plate-reader licence)
rows.establishes: 130 plate-reader licences at $516 each were priced in the ordering document.
rows.does_not_establish: That plate-reader capability was 4.5% of the purchase in any operational sense.
rows.caveat: Defined by the vendor's price file as CarDetector Mobile with Vigilant PlateSearch, agency data only.

rows.label: Basic Remote Support for WG LPR License
rows.establishes: A one-time plate-reader support and configuration line was priced.

rows.label: City Contract/PO 24209
rows.establishes: The approved amount was committed across FY24-FY28.
rows.caveat: The 2023 print reads “Page 1 of 4”; pages 2-4 have not been produced.

rows.label: LEARN / VehicleManager hosted account
rows.establishes: The hosted plate-reader platform account sits on the Vigilant / H-GAC contract.
rows.caveat: The Mobile Video Addendum expressly equates LEARN with Vigilant VehicleManager.

rows.label: Commercial national vehicle-location data
rows.document: Quote DOB-0015-10; invoice 52887 RI against Contract 24089
rows.establishes: Three years of access to commercially acquired national vehicle-location data, invoiced 15 August 2023.
rows.does_not_establish: How the data was used, or by whom.
rows.caveat: The $11,250/yr rate is promotional and reverts to $31,440/yr.

rows.label: Mobile Companion licences
rows.establishes: Ten licences at no charge in year one.

rows.label: Fixed roadside plate-reader cameras and comms boxes
rows.establishes: Fixed cameras were quoted, ordered and confirmed through the cooperative.
rows.does_not_establish: That they were installed, activated or operating.
rows.caveat: Quantity is unsettled: quote 6, invoice 7 kits, hosted service billed for 5, export shows 7 lane cameras across 2 fixed systems. Cite the document or say “at least six.”

rows.label: Hosted LPR service for the fixed cameras
rows.establishes: A hosted service period billed from October 2023.
rows.caveat: The quote states it “requires new/existing Enterprise Service Agreement (ESA).” No ESA appears in the records produced.

rows.label: In-product opt-in outbound sharing
rows.establishes: Sharing plate data with another qualifying agency requires nothing but a setting. No memorandum, notice, review or approval is required by the agreement.
rows.does_not_establish: That any sharing occurred, or when any relationship was configured.
rows.caveat: On page 9 of the 25-page clerk's file.

rows.label: Chained sub-processor consent
rows.establishes: Sub-processors and their sub-processors may process Customer Data under their own terms.
rows.does_not_establish: That any sub-processor exists, is named, or has processed Des Moines plate data.
rows.caveat: No list, flow-down or notification obligation appears in the agreement.

rows.label: Audit right (vendor → City only)
rows.establishes: The vendor may audit the City's credentialed user count.
rows.does_not_establish: Any City-side audit, inspection or log-access right. None appears in the reviewed instruments.
rows.caveat: Not found is not the same as nonexistence.

rows.label: Storage location in vendor's sole discretion
rows.establishes: The vendor determines storage location, subject to a US-location commitment for US customers.
rows.does_not_establish: Where the data is in fact stored.

rows.label: City termination right on changes in Iowa law
rows.establishes: The City may terminate on 30 days' notice if Iowa law makes the equipment substantially unusable.
rows.does_not_establish: That the right has been exercised or considered.

rows.label: The “Customer Data” definitional chain
rows.document: Mobile Video Addendum §4.5; W24-152; Sourcewell 010720-WCH; Motorola Solutions Customer Agreement (Sept 2024 edition)
rows.establishes: The term the clause turns on is not defined in either document the addendum names as the Master Agreement, and the vendor's customer agreement refers onward to a vendor-hosted Data Processing Addendum that may change from time to time and that claims precedence in a conflict.
rows.does_not_establish: What the November 2023 definition said. The only edition in the record is dated September 2024.
rows.caveat: Do not say the term is defined in the Master Customer Agreement.

rows.label: Outbound sharing configuration
rows.establishes: At least 155 configured outbound sharing relationships across 36 states and the District of Columbia.
rows.does_not_establish: That any plate record was transferred, queried or viewed; and not when any relationship was configured.
rows.caveat: The export is filtered on “Sharing status : Sharing.” 155 is a floor.

rows.label: Inbound receiving configuration
rows.establishes: 120 rows show a receiving relationship; 15 none; 12 approval required; 8 declined.
rows.caveat: Direction labels are inferred from vendor terminology, not stated in the file.

rows.label: Systems and cameras in the platform
rows.establishes: 149 top-level system rows — 140 Mobile, 7 IP, 2 Fixed — with 560 nested cameras.
rows.does_not_establish: How many systems were installed, operating or reading plates.
rows.caveat: Counting the 7 IP lane units as cameras instead of systems yields the alternative shorthand of 142 systems and 567 cameras. One Mobile row is literally named “Unit number.”

rows.label: User accounts on the platform
rows.establishes: 386 accounts: 381 Operator, 5 Advanced Agency Manager.
rows.does_not_establish: That 386 people can search. Accounts are not people.
rows.caveat: Includes duplicates, API, proxy and site accounts, and one account on a vendor domain. No account names appear in this exhibit.

rows.label: Actual transfers, queries, hits and viewings
rows.establishes: Nothing. This layer is empty in the produced record, and the exhibit draws it as empty.
rows.does_not_establish: That no search ever happened, and not that no log exists anywhere. The City stated it does not generate or keep copies of search logs; department policy requires regular audits and one audit entry reviewing 500 records is in the record.
rows.caveat: Distinguish four things: what the City retains · what the City produced · what the contract allows · what any transfer is established to show.
